statement: The operation ledger's raft leader never silently freezes its local persistence while remaining leader: in run-23 (~08:02:58, node fe93cde6, replica_operations-p1-r4) the leader's log append and apply BOTH stopped at raft index 149 with ZERO error or warning logged, while it stayed in-memory leader and all three followers committed entries 150-155 without it — from that moment no transition UPDATE entered the raft log cluster-wide (transition UPDATEs are sql-routed writes executed at the leader: 'DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE writeMode sql-routed firstFailedParticipant replica_operations-p1 Query timeout after 1ms') and every OWNER_LOCAL_ONLY visibility confirm read the frozen store, so coordinators locally completed nearly the entire pinned set (all ten stalled operations plus the phase-2 provisioning op reached local 'Operation completed') yet nothing ever became authoritative — formation hit the 120s stall cut and CREATE TABLE died downstream on routability. The fix makes the leader's LOCAL persistence health part of leadership fitness: persist/apply failures at the leader surface loudly (run-23's swallow site logged nothing) and a leader whose applied store lags the group's committed frontier beyond a bounded staleness steps down (or transition writes and confirms stop depending on the leader's local applied store) — without weakening raft safety or raising timeouts/budgets. Proven FIRST by a deterministic in-process reproduction that wedges the ledger leader's local persistence mid-formation and red-on-reverts the recovery (transitions become authoritative via step-down/re-route instead of freezing), and then by the live affinity demo's formation settling completing with the ratings load surviving phase 2.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

RUNG 0 (mandatory, before sealing any fix direction): find the SWALLOW SITE and the freeze mechanism in code — run-23 shows the leader stopped appending AND applying with zero logs, so some persistence-path failure is caught-and-dropped or a loop died silently (candidates: sqlite write errors in the partition raft log store, the apply loop promise chain, wal/fsync errors, the 1ms Query timeout budget on ledger participants). Evidence base: scratchpad research-run23-binding-head.md + run23-ledger/ db copies (leader frozen committedIndex 149, followers 155, entries 150-155 all INSERT OR IGNORE, no UPDATE cluster-wide after 149), archive run23-logs-2026-07-05T08-00-manual-preserve.tar.gz; node fe93cde6 never logged replica_operations-p1 again after 08:02:58 until shutdown. Also verify the write-routing claim: transition UPDATEs execute at the LEADER via sql-routed writes while INSERTs (OR IGNORE) still committed via followers — explain that asymmetry in code before designing.

RUNG 1 (mandatory, before any src change): deterministic in-process reproduction wedging the ledger leader local persistence mid-formation on the DT substrate, red-on-revert via dt:prove. Prior art: test/convergence/dt6-formation-ledger-quorum-spread-first.test.js and dt6-voter-surplus-promotion-drain-livelock.test.js (createTimeoutTestCoordinator fixture, virtual owner timers via setTimeoutFn with promise-returning callbacks, gateway-seam fault injection, canonical replicaId from create outcome). Live demo runs are validation only (gate-runs-last-resort-only).

Adversarially vet before implementation: (a) step-down-on-local-staleness must not cause leadership flap under transient disk pressure (bounded staleness, hysteresis; the raft-candidacy-reluctance and leadership-flap census lessons apply); (b) decoupling transition writes/confirms from the leader-local applied store must not reintroduce the CL-017 self-reference storm or weaken ARCH-0080/0084 actuals discipline; (c) run-23 is single-run forensics — confirm the freeze is reproducible-by-mechanism (not a demo-host artifact like disk saturation) before sealing; the fix must still be correct if the freeze WAS environmental (a silent environmental freeze must still surface and shed leadership). (d) Reuse ruling: raft health/step-down machinery exists (deferCandidacy, requestTrackedPartitionLeaderHandoff, readiness dimensions) — extend, never parallel-build; REUSED vs EXTENDED vs NEW section mandatory in the fix report.

No timeout or budget raises (TEST-0021); actuals only for any new gate inputs (ARCH-0080/0084); local gates before every commit (test:complexity + lint; parse error = false ratchet pass). Related recorded classes: the terminal-transition repair (this quest is WHY its confirms could not land in run-23 — the repair is a consumer of this fix, do not modify it), the cross-instance duplicate-move class (P2 rebalancer-own-create-memory-duplicate-replace, broadened to cross-coordinator move-execution idempotency — contributing but self-resolving in run-23), the duplicate-emergency-ADD voter-surplus genesis (incidental in run-23, still recorded).
